Laplacian of Def. 2.3/Eq. 2 is not canonical (arbitrary +1 position changes the spectrum) and Thm 4.2 smoothness fails on constants

notes: Ran sequentially in one shared context (disclosed in review.md). Ambiguities: (1) the DA CRITICAL criteria say evidence supporting only a weaker claim is MAJOR, but give no rule for a theorem that is proved false while empirical results survive; I used criterion 1 and the EIC upheld it, which is a judgment call that decides the DA cap (not binding here since the starting point was already 2). (2) Phase 1.5 is meant to run after the five reports, but in one context the reviewers had already read everything; I wrote the reports first and added the literature addendum afterward. (3) related_search.py `novelty` does not accept --fp although the other subcommands do, and `benchmarks` returned empty for a paper without named external benchmarks (MolHIV, PROTEIN not recognised), so no baseline scout table could be built. (4) The 4-concept-word limit refused two natural queries; refused queries are not counted but the budget of 12 is tight for 4 claims plus benchmarks. (5) Paper type: a method paper with a headline theoretical claim; the empirical weights were chosen, a theoretical weighting would have lowered the composite further. (6) The sandbox blocked shell variables, loops and output redirection, so queries were run one per call and the final review.md was assembled with a Python one-liner; this is an environment limit, not a skill problem. (7) Phase 1.6 allows rewriting weaknesses but reviewers' scores are fixed; I rewrote two statements (R2-W3, R3-W1) after checking kept abstracts and my own derivation.
